description: For progress payment, this checklist records earned-value basis, percent complete, authorized changes, deductions, lien requirements, and forecast balance. Its supporting evidence includes quantity backup, site photos, delivery proof, stored-material inventory, payroll record, and inspection status.

use_case: Use the checklist during progress-payment application review when the progress payment record must identify schedule of values, pay period, contract modifications, retainage, stored materials, and prior certificates. Complete the applicable handoff for certified amount, exception ledger, accounting handoff, updated continuation sheet, and payment record.
